reasons.plausibility: Reducing thermal gradients via substrate preheating is a well-known method in additive manufacturing to limit residual stress and segregation, so the mechanism is scientifically sound with only minor open questions about potential phase formation issues.
reasons.testability: A clear A/B comparison (with and without preheating) and subsequent microstructural, residual stress, and mechanical testing would directly confirm or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: Substrate preheating is a practical, industry-relevant approach for improving mechanical performance in high-entropy alloys while mitigating common drawbacks, thus making it a valuable line of research.
